name.fr-FR: L’Année liturgique : le temps de Noël, I
name.en-US: The Liturgical Year: Christmas, Book I
name.pt-BR: O Ano Litúrgico: o tempo do Natal, I

description.fr-FR: Deuxième volume de l’Année liturgique : historique, mystique et pratique du temps de Noël, le saint jour de Noël, puis les fêtes du 26 décembre à la vigile de l’Épiphanie.
description.en-US: Volume 2 of the 15-volume Liturgical Year (L’Année liturgique) in the original French: Christmas, Book I. One chapter per day or feast, with the liturgical texts in Latin and French as the edition prints them.
description.pt-BR: Volume 2 dos 15 volumes de «O Ano Litúrgico» (L’Année liturgique) em francês: o tempo do Natal, I. Um capítulo por dia ou festa, com os textos litúrgicos em latim e francês como a edição os imprime.

fr-FR.editor: Dom Prosper Guéranger, abbé de Solesmes (14th ed., Oudin)

sources.description: Dom Guéranger site (Societas pro canonizatione D. Guéranger), WordPress text of the 14th edition (1900). Split at each day or feast heading; verse kept as hard line breaks; footnotes renumbered per chapter.
sources.tierEvidence: Guéranger died in 1875; the text is the 19th-century edition transcribed.
